stem.text: The diagram allows the identification of different types of immunity.

stem.alt: Tree diagram. The top label "immunity" branches to "short term" (labelled 1) and "long term". Under "short term" are the boxes "acquired by fetus from the maternal circulation across the placenta" and "acquired by injection of antibodies into the bloodstream". Under "long term" are the boxes "acquired as a result of infection by a pathogen" (labelled 2) and "acquired by injection of an attenuated pathogen" (labelled 3).

stem.text: Which row correctly identifies the types of immunity labelled 1, 2 and 3?
